text.p: These were the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's news report on Monday afternoon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The chairman of parliament Vytautas Landsbergis told a news conference on Monday that none of the 10 candidates were completely ready to join the European Union and Lithuania, even without an invitation, should do its best to meet the requirements of the trade bloc.
- Experts from Lithuania and Cyprus intend to sign an agreement this month to open a regular airline route between the two countries.
- President Algirdas Brazauskas started an official visit in France on Monday, which will be broken briefly as he travels to Madrid for the NATO summit.
